card.name: Historical and scholarly text, early 20th century
card.fires_on: Scattered tokens in history and philosophy passages about 19th and early 20th century Europe, such as partway through names, years, and linking words like the, for, this. It does not depend on a single word type.

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese words about publishing and releases and away from words about past eras, so the output effect is weak and mixed.
